name: error_something_went_wrong_no_sections_upload_ok
body_text: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
spec: "error" when the page text shows a Workday error: "Something went wrong" ... This wins over everything else

name: error_session_expired_beats_work_section_and_failed_upload
body_text: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
spec: "error" when the page text shows a Workday error: ... "session expired" ... This wins over everything else (an old draft / expired session — rerun fresh, then the candidate withdraws the draft).

name: error_session_has_expired_uppercase
spec: "error" when the page text shows a Workday error: ... "session has expired" ... (case-insensitive).

name: error_session_timed_out
body_text: Session timed out after 20 minutes of inactivity.
spec: "error" when the page text shows a Workday error: ... "session timed out" ... (case-insensitive).

name: error_an_error_occurred_beats_education_section
body_text: An error occurred while saving your changes.
spec: "error" when the page text shows a Workday error: ... "an error occurred" ... This wins over everything else

name: error_an_error_has_occurred_uppercase
body_text: AN ERROR HAS OCCURRED. Please refresh.
spec: "error" when the page text shows a Workday error: ... "an error has occurred" ... (case-insensitive).

name: error_page_not_available_beats_resume_only
spec: "error" when the page text shows a Workday error: ... "page not available" / "page is unavailable" (case-insensitive). This wins over everything else

name: error_page_is_unavailable_with_language_section
body_text: This page is unavailable right now.
spec: "error" when the page text shows a Workday error: ... "page is unavailable" ... This wins over everything else

name: near_miss_generic_word_error_no_phrase
body_text: No errors were found on this page.
spec: "error" when the page text shows a Workday error: "Something went wrong", "session expired" / "session has expired" / "session timed out", "an error occurred" / "an error has occurred", "page not available" / "page is unavailable" (case-insensitive). — none of these phrases is present.

name: near_miss_session_not_expired
spec: "error" when the page text shows a Workday error: ... "session expired" / "session has expired" / "session timed out" ... — the phrase "session expired" does not appear here.

name: no_sections_with_successful_upload
spec: No sections at all + upload successful = "resume-only".

name: resume_cv_and_attachments_headings_only
spec: A section whose heading names the résumé, CV, curriculum vitae or attachments does not count as such a section even if it also contains one of those words (e.g. "Resume/CV", "Attachments").

name: websites_and_social_network_urls_headings_only
spec: Other headings like "Websites" or "Social Network URLs" do not count either.

name: curriculum_vitae_heading_only
spec: A section whose heading names the résumé, CV, curriculum vitae or attachments does not count as such a section

name: work_experience_section_present_nothing_rendered
spec: "empty" otherwise: a work / education / language section exists but nothing rendered

name: education_section_with_successful_upload
spec: "empty" otherwise: a work / education / language section exists but nothing rendered

name: languages_section_with_successful_upload
spec: "empty" otherwise: a work / education / language section exists but nothing rendered

name: no_sections_but_upload_not_successful
spec: "empty" otherwise: ... or the upload is not successful. The runner then stops and never advances unchecked.

name: websites_only_but_upload_failed
spec: "empty" otherwise: ... or the upload is not successful.

name: resume_cv_only_but_upload_failed
spec: "resume-only" when there is no error, the résumé upload is successful, and none of the sections is a work / employment / experience / education / academic / school / language section. — upload not successful, so it falls through to "empty" ... or the upload is not successful.

name: professional_experience_heading
spec: "empty" otherwise: a work / education / language section exists but nothing rendered

name: resume_and_work_experience_heading_combined
spec: A section whose heading names the résumé, CV, curriculum vitae or attachments does not count as such a section even if it also contains one of those words (e.g. "Resume/CV", "Attachments"). — Ambiguous: the only worked example ("Resume/CV") contains no work/education trigger word, so it is unclear whether the exemption really overrides a heading that also names "Work Experience".

name: academic_background_heading
spec: "empty" otherwise: a work / education / language section exists but nothing rendered — "academic" sections are listed among those that block resume-only.

name: employment_history_heading_upload_ok
spec: "resume-only" when ... none of the sections is a work / employment / experience / education / academic / school / language section. — "Employment History" is such a section, so the result is "empty".

name: uppercase_education_heading_only
spec: "empty" otherwise: a work / education / language section exists but nothing rendered. — Ambiguous: case-insensitivity is stated only for the error phrases, not for section headings, so matching "EDUCATION" to "education" is an assumption.
